# Neuromorphic_NoC_Routing

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A routing strategy in a Network-on-Chip that accounts for the event-driven, sparse, and timing-sensitive nature of spike traffic in neuromorphic processors. This ensures that spike delivery meets real-time constraints while minimizing congestion, critical for scaling iNEST systems on TCC fabrics.
